verdict.rationale: DPMA is the German patent and trade mark office. Its online services cover patent search (DEPATISnet), the register (DPMAregister) and e-filing (DPMAdirektWeb/Pro). It is not an AI agent or host application that would act as an MCP client, so plugging in MCP servers to use their tools is a category error for this product type. The evidence also shows no AI-agent capability that would make the axis apply.
